_note_mcd_S1kq_N96: Stage 1 (mcd_S1_N96.json) with kappa_Q 2.06 in place of 2.234; every other value and switch is that of mcd_S1_N96.json. kappa_Q 2.06 (range 2.04-2.09), status M: the white-area budget re-measured under pose track v2 from the total white area at 1.9 / 2.78 / 4.87 s (tulip) and 2.78 s (leaf); it consumes those frames, the window of T3_tulip_area and T2_tulip_rear_onset / _advancing. Installed by the fsc24 DX1 re-base rule, which held at N 96 and N 144 (record parity p95 <= 0.19 mm; white-area ratios video / sim 0.993-1.011, a linearity check of area in kappa_Q, not an independent test). This is the re-base of a measured parameter, not the adoption of a mechanism: no independent target changed verdict (6 / 23 cleaned passes, as Stage 1 under pose v2), and the protected T2_leaf_rear_receding (kappa_s-consumed) moved from pass (-0.15) to fail (+0.69 / +0.73 against [-3.56, 0.23]). Status of carried values after fsc24 (SPEC3 2.2): tau_s 0.075 s places the surfacing source tau_s u_in, about 8.5 mm, ahead of the landing point; the excursion law excludes that as a relaxation distance (3.2-5.6 mm under every bracket), so tau_s is carried as this reference's placement of the source without an independent estimate; kappa_c and p_dep remain fitted without an independent estimate. src26 (validated milk column, LATTE_FOOT=col; tulip and leaf only): measured about the column with the same functions as the video, this closure fails three column-relative checks in the solver at N 96 and N 144: the leaf ring centre (+9.25 / +9.14 mm against the video's +3.17, beyond the allowance by 1.83 / 1.88 mm under both references), the tulip rear-ring white share T9 (0.94; the rear is wrapped by 0.95 s, the video's not before 1.79 s), and the leaf rear crema speed (+3.24 mm/s outward against -2.15 inward). With the source moved to the column's downstream edge (tau_s 0.028, a diagnostic run, never adopted; the emulator's near-field transfer validated, 0 / 14 misses at both grids) the leaf ring becomes +3.98 / +3.29, but the leaf rear moves 0.58 mm/s further outward and the tulip wrap 0.28 s earlier: the edge placement is not admissible alone. tau_s 0.075 therefore stays carried until the edge source is built together with a derived rear-holding mechanism at the column.
